name: DIC Corporation
summary: DIC Corporation produces and distributes printing inks, organic pigments and polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) compounds worldwide through Packaging & Graphic, Color & Display, and Functional Products segments. Packaging & Graphic supplies printing consumables such as gravure, flexo, offset, news and security inks, while Functional Products includes PPS and other functional compounds, masterbatches, construction materials, hollow fiber membrane modules, and adhesive and magnetic tapes for industry.
